class.name: HEGoOutputHandler
class.brief_description: Teaches HEGo to turn another kind of cook result into Godot nodes.
class.description: HEGo itself builds meshes, multimeshes, spawned objects and curves. Another addon adds a kind by extending this class and giving it a [code]class_name[/code]: HEGo finds every global class that extends it, in the editor and in exported games alike, so installing that addon is all it takes. The dependency only runs one way. The extending addon names HEGo's classes; HEGo never names the addon's. The HEGo Terrain3D bridge, for example, builds Terrain3D terrains and instances this way. [method HEGoNode3D.output_handlers] runs these after HEGo's own mesh, multimesh and object output and before its curve output, sorted by class name. Every method has a default that handles nothing, so a handler overrides only what it needs. Handlers are created once and reused, so keep per-cook state in the [HEGoOutputContext] [method handle] is given, not on the handler.

method.name: output_phase
method.description: Name of the cook phase this handler is timed under, shown in the cook timings. Ends in [code]_output[/code] by convention. Defaults to the class name in snake case.

method.name: should_handle
method.description: Whether the cook has anything for this handler, judged from [param summary], what [method HEGoAssetNode.get_output_summary] reported. Use [method HEGoNodeUtil.output_has] and [method HEGoNodeUtil.output_has_attribute], which run the handler whenever the summary could not be read: skipping is only for positive knowledge that there is nothing to do.

method.name: handle
method.description: Builds this handler's output for the cook in [param context]. May await. Runs after the host's [HEGoCookExtension]s have committed and the previous [code]Outputs[/code] subtree has been cleared.

method.name: handles_heightfields
method.description: Whether this handler turns the cook's heightfield volumes into terrain. A [HEGoCookExtension] that consumes the heightfields itself skips such handlers through [method HEGoCookExtension.skips_output_handler] without having to name them.

method.name: extension_handlers
method.description: The output handlers other addons provide: one instance of every global class that extends [HEGoOutputHandler], sorted by class name. Rescanned whenever the project's class list changes, so an addon installed in an open editor is picked up without a restart.

constants.constant: Class every extension output handler extends.
